estimates.assumptions: 2 medium skinless chicken breasts (approx 200 g each raw, edible portion); plain meat has zero carbs/fiber
1 tbsp neutral cooking oil; pure oil has zero carbs/fiber
4 tbsp hot/chilli sauce (standard commercial type); based on typical values ~3g carbs per tbsp
juice of ½ lemon (approx 30 ml); typical lemon juice carb content
2 medium burger buns (approx 70 g each); standard white burger bun values
250 g halloumi cheese (the 'Cheese' listed; pan- or air-fried); typical halloumi carb content ~3 g per 100 g
¼ small white cabbage, finely shredded (approx 150 g edible portion); typical cabbage values
2 tbsp mayonnaise; standard full-fat mayo values
4 tbsp sour cream; typical full-fat sour cream values
4 lettuce leaves (approx 40 g total); typical lettuce values
2 medium red peppers, sliced (approx 160 g total edible portion); typical red bell pepper values
